name: Mesenteric Vessels
description: Superior mesenteric artery (SMA) and inferior mesenteric artery (IMA) with their accompanying veins. SMA arises from the aorta at L1, supplies midgut. IMA arises at L3, supplies hindgut. On CT: assess for thrombosis/embolism (mesenteric ischemia), stenosis, aneurysm, and SMV thrombosis.
